# Print method for enhanced White test results

<small>Source: [`R/performWhiteTest.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/performWhiteTest.R) · Help: `?print.htest_enhanced`</small>

Print method for enhanced White test results

## Usage

```r
## S3 method for class 'htest_enhanced'
print(x, ...)
```

## Arguments

`x`
:   An `htest` of class `htest_enhanced`, whose `interpretation`
    element is printed after it. No function of the package returns one:
    `performWhiteTestEnhanced()`, which is internal, returns an `htest`.

`...`
:   Further arguments passed to `print.htest()`.
